services.name: Mom + Baby Fitness Classes
services.desc: There is no question that having a baby changes your body and your life forever - but that doesn’t have to mean the end of your self-care! Our mom + baby fitness are specifically designed for new moms to help you rebuild strength, community, and a sense of self in the year following the arrival of your child. You can expect to sweat, laugh, and meet new friends who are going through the same experiences you are, all with your baby safely by your side. Babies from age 6 weeks (or upon medical clearance) to 12 months are welcome in our Strong as a Motha’ classes. Babies 6 months - 18 months are welcome to join our Mom + Baby LIFT classes. The best part? We offer 4 classes weekly, and flexible

services.name: Group Fitness Classes
services.desc: Life is complicated. Your workout routine shouldn’t be.You want results, convenience, and variety. You want to feel better with each passing day, week, and month. You want a routine that you can actually stick with.That is why at CrushCamp, we offer 4 totally unique, custom-designed, science-backed class types, designed to complement each other and help you get in the best shape of your life. Our signature workout is a 45-minute High Intensity Interval Training (HIIT) class that combines cardio intervals on the SKILLMILL with strength training on the floor using dumbbells, kettlebells, and bands.
